integrity: The analytic proof, definitions and exact Markov-chain example are contained in RESULT.md. The included checks are finite corroboration, not independent validation or replacements for proof.
scientific_limitations: Three centered Brownian coordinates only, with strictly positive-definite difference covariance.
Two-sided power bounds only: no exact lower-tail leading constant or uniformity at degenerate covariance boundaries.
No claim for finite random-word samples, higher-dimensional Brownian last passage, or uncentered sum direction.
title: Sharp small-deviation exponent for three-line correlated Brownian last passage
